//: Not embedded and never loaded at runtime (see uStrings.pas -- locale 'en' always returns each call site's own inline default, so this file can never itself drift out of sync). This is the authoring template: every key a translator needs, next to its current English text, to build strings/<locale>.json from. Keep it in sync with the T()/TDialog() call sites as they're added, so a translator always has the full list.
//dialogs_note: Ids intentionally omitted here (and so untranslated) are always overwritten at runtime via DialogSetLabelText/DialogSetTitle before the dialog is shown -- translating their JSON default would never be seen. Multi-column list headers (assocHeader, header in colorcoding/joblist/keymap, hotlistHeader, sshHeader, wsHeader) are padded to line up with data rows the Pascal code positions independently: a translation must start every column at the same offset as the English header and fit before the next one (TestStrings checks assocHeader).
